_comment: Keys must match your Twitch reward TITLES exactly (matching is case-insensitive and trims whitespace). 'seconds' is the timer duration added on redemption -- re-redeeming the same reward while its bar is already counting down EXTENDS it by this amount instead of restarting it. This file is re-read on every redemption, so you can edit and save it live.
